title: Batch125 finite frontier: canonical E/Q capabilities by source lane

registryAtAudit.identityRule: Canonical coverage uses exact `characterKey` + `action`; native method coverage is separately counted by `sourcePath` + `method`. This preserves traveler form bindings while exposing shared implementations.

post124MetadataDifferences: Frontier source hashes use exact PRE124 frozen source roots. Batch124 instrumentation added branch facts for Chasca E (blessing-at-entry and pending-aim-release), Xilonen E (blessing-at-entry), and Stellar Qiqi Q (Stellar Conduct); these remain distinct from the native roots.
Classic117 has 234 canonical E/Q bindings over 222 unique method implementations. Stellar124 has 248 bindings over 234 unique implementations.
semanticLimit: All uncovered entries receive exact source method/hash/call-site triage. The triage does not claim zero or complete from the method body alone; event, entity, callback, helper, and delayed-task ownership require following source links.
